verdict.rationale: Tavily's Search API takes natural-language questions (e.g. "Who is Leo Messi?") and has a search-depth setting that controls the latency-vs-relevance tradeoff. Its opt-in exact_match mode suggests default search is not strict keyword matching. However, nothing in the pack explicitly describes semantic or embedding-based retrieval, or shows results that keyword engines miss. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party description of meaning-based ranking, evidence of finding results keyword search misses, and independent or hands-on corroboration of semantic search quality.
